Four things are wider than a phone and only one of them is mine to shorten.

## What is wide in this repo

Four kinds of content are hostile to a narrow terminal, and only one of them is prose:

- a token nothing can break: `NewRunnerWithBudgetAndInboxAndLockManagerAndTimerAndDeadlineAndRetryPolicy`
- a url, same problem: https://github.com/arxi/arxi/blob/main/internal/surface/render/wrap.go#L118-L141
- 全角文字は一文字で二セル分の幅を占めるので、折り返しは表示幅で数えないと必ずずれる。
- markers a font may or may not have: ✅ 🚀 ⚠️ 🔒 📦 🧪 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦

| what | how wide | bounded by |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `tool.args` | unbounded | nothing: a bash command can be a whole script |
| `tool.result.summary` | unbounded | `max_output_bytes`, which is a byte count and not a column count |
| a base64 payload | 312 columns | the model's patience |

result.summary: read 4096 lines; the widest is 312 columns and holds a base64 payload, so at 40 columns it becomes eight rows and at 20 columns it becomes sixteen, which is the entire reason this scenario exists

payload.text: The table goes first: nothing renders it as a table, so at 40 columns it is five wrapped paragraphs of pipes. 全角の行 wraps correctly because the wrapper counts display width. The long token is cut mid-word on purpose — an overflowing line corrupts inline mode, and a cut one only looks bad.
